newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Gate Gourmet targets U.S. presence in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Gate Gourmet targets U.S. presence in 1997.

text.p: Gate Gourmet's strategic goal for 1997 is to establish a presence in the U.S., a hole in the global presence of the SAirGroup subsidiary, its president said.
Henning Boysen, president and chief executive of Gate Gourment International, said this presence in the U.S. could take a variety of forms, including cooperation and alliances.
"Our goal in 1997 is to establish a presence in the U.S.," Boysen told journalists.
The U.S. catering market is dominated by some 80 percent by Dobbs International Services and LSG Skychef, a unit of Deutsche Lufthansa AG.
While Gate Gourmet has been expanding strongly in Europe and gradually in Asia and Latin America, it has no U.S. presence.
Major airlines with global networks prefer to reach global supply agreements with one catering company that serves the airline worldwide.
Boysen said the lack of a U.S. presence was a problem for Gate Gourmet when talking to U.S. airlines.
"We are handicapped when negotiating with U.S. airlines," Boysen said.
While Gate Gourmet and LSG are strong competitors in Europe, Dobbs hardly has a European presence, Boysen said.
